Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. S.C. Dumka, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. Present C-528 application has been filed seeking to set aside the order dated 09.04.2025 passed in Complaint Case No.3194 of 2018, whereby the application for discharge of the applicant has been rejected; further seeking to set aside/quash the order dated 08.05.2025 whereby charges under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C. have been framed; further seeking to set aside/quash the order dated 19.01.2026 whereby the criminal revision preferred by the applicant has been dismissed, as well as to quash the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that a complaint was filed by respondent no.2,
wherein it has been alleged that the applicant, claiming himself to be the tenure holder of one Pyare Singh S/o Nandan Singh, executed a sale deed in favour of Charanjeet Singh, who is the son of the present applicant; that, in the said complaint case, the applicant has been summoned for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C. Thereafter, charges have been framed against the applicant vide order dated 08.05.2025.
The applicant challenged the said order by filing a criminal revision, which has been dismissed by the learned court below vide judgment and order dated 19.01.2026.
5. Learned counsel would further submit that the court below has erred in framing charges against the applicant.

It is contended that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case inasmuch as the alleged sale deed, which is the subject matter of the complaint, has neither been executed nor signed by the applicant.
It is further submitted that the applicant is neither a witness to the alleged sale deed nor a beneficiary thereof.

Learned counsel further submits that earlier Civil Suit No.108 of 2013 was filed by respondent no.2 before the learned Civil Judge, Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar seeking cancellation of the alleged sale deed, which came to be dismissed vide judgment and order dated 23.02.2023.

8. Steps to be taken within one week.

10. Objections, if any, be filed by the State/respondent.
11.

Meanwhile, further proceedings of Complaint Case No.3194 of 2018, 'Pyara Singh vs. Gurmail Singh and Others', pending before the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar, shall remain stayed till the next date of listing.
